alias_rule: assigning one object reference to another local copies the receiver identity; it does not create a fresh heap object
allocation_rule: distinct new-expression sites remain distinct receiver identities
field_rule: distinct property paths remain distinct even when the receiver aliases
overwrite_rule: a later exact write through any alias replaces the prior exact state value for that receiver/property identity
unknown_rule: when receiver aliasing is not proven, do not merge receiver identities and do not emit a COMPLETE return summary
